original_value: Seagate Enterprise Capacity V.5 6TB hard drive, part number ST6000NM0095. This internal 3.5-inch HDD uses a 12.0Gbps SAS interface and SAS-12GBPS sub-type. Key specs include 6 TB storage, 512e bytes per sector, a 2 million hour MTBF, humidity sensor, halogen-free design, and PowerChoice technology. Performance details: 226 MBPS maximum sustained transfer rate at OD, 4.16 MS average latency, dual interface ports, 12.5 rotation vibration at 1500 Hz (RAD/S²), 256 MB buffer, and 7200 RPM rotational speed.
